description: Running 0x0011 interface status from the authentic Dante A32 firmware (Ferrofish A32 4.0.8.2, Brooklyn II) executing as the netaudio-a32-emulator lab device A32-000040 on 2026-09-11, primary interface in DHCP mode after taking a lease from a lab dnsmasq whose options were deliberately distinct: router 192.168.1.1 and dns-server 8.8.8.8. The LAN router's DHCP replies to the device MAC were dropped on the bridge so only the lab lease could be accepted; the dnsmasq log recorded DHCPREQUEST and DHCPACK for the device MAC with those options.
allowed_evidence: Device ConMon reply captured in-process by netaudio's own interface-status probe
Lab DHCP server log establishing the lease options handed to the device
excluded_evidence: Proprietary executable or firmware static inspection
claim: In a dynamic (DHCP) running interface record the DNS server is at record offset +16 and the gateway at +20, the same layout as the static record; the earlier mode-dependent swap read them reversed (GitHub issue #47).
source_tool: netaudio probe_interface_status with an in-process ConMon 0x0011 hook
